containers._doc: Containers (v0.7.18.1, ContainerRules): kinds by a catalog item id or furniture (with `name`) — capacity_lb by 5e (a chest 300 lb, a barrel and a basket by volume, a backpack and a sack 30, a pouch 6, a bag of holding 500 and weightless inside), lockable; lock_dc of a lock by its quality; force_dc_plus — Athletics to break it open.
containers._bags: v0.7.22.9 (the author's request): what lies in a bag weighs bag_weight_share of its weight (a bag of holding — nothing); the hero carries at most worn_bags of each size as bags (a backpack or a sack — big, a pouch — small), more of them are plain things; a bag does not go into a bag.

development._doc: Peaceful development (v0.7.19.1, DevelopmentRules): the 5e levelling carried over to peaceful deeds — a direction has its own experience (`xp` — the experience of levels 0–5), its sources (`sources`) and its skills, one picked on every level from those of a level ≤ the direction's (`needs` — skills taken first); a skill's `effect` works only in the deeds of its direction. Trade: buy_pct / sell_pct (prices), haggle_adv, haggle_plus (percent of a won haggle), haggle_retry (a failed haggle does not lock the day once), no_haggle_escalation, other_mult (other goods ×0.7 → ×0.7·mult), saturation_mult, max_ratio (the ceiling of a sell price).

jobs._doc: Work (v0.7.26, JobRules): a job is data — the employer (an NPC), the check of a shift (`skill`, a carried `tool` helps; or a `tool` alone — its ability of craft.tools + proficiency), `hours` of a shift, `dc`, `pay_cp` a shift, `requires` (tool — proficiency in the job's tool, skill — proficiency in its skill, language, reputation — the least step in the employer's place) and `ranks` (names; the numbers by `ranks` here). Jobs of the pack (world.json `jobs`) and the master's (effect `job`, within `make`). Hired after `hire` — the skill against the employer by SocialRules.dc, a failure — again after `retry_days`. A shift goes only while the employer is in the room, any number a day: the check, the outcome by the margin (`outcomes`, the last whose `from` is reached) — the pay share, tips, the employer's attitude, a good one counts to the promotion after `promote_after` good shifts (attitude +1). A shift's event (`event_chance`, one of `events`) is narrated by the master. Experience — the direction `work` of rules.development.

property._doc: Property (v0.7.27, PropertyRules): a property is a site (location → site → room) on sale — the pack's `properties`, the master's (effect `property`) or built on own land. Bought from its seller (an NPC), it is the hero's de facto; the deed (`registry` — an NPC tagged registry, the fee `fee_pct` of the price) makes it de jure. Without a deed: no tax, but past `dispute.grace_days` each week a `dispute.chance` that the town takes it back. With one: a tax of `tax.pct` of the price every `tax.every_days`, from the till, else a debt; a debt of `tax.seize_weeks` weeks — seized. `kinds`: what the place is — `income_cp_day` (with a worker or the hero's own shift), the shift's `skill` and `hours`, the worker's `role` and `wage_cp_day`, `buildable` (land). `decay_per_day` of the condition (100 → 0; a worker keeps it at `decay_worker`), the income × condition below `worn_below`; repair `repair_pct` of the price per 100 points, an hour per `repair_points_hour`. `upgrades` — what a place gains (`station` tag, `rest`, `storage`, `income_pct`, `private`, `feed_mult`, `decay_mult`), its price and days; `build` — buildings on land: rooms, kind, price, days. `animals` — beasts bought (an SRD template): price, feed a day, `travel_mult` while led, `fights` (an ally), `produce` a day at an own place; unfed `starve_days` — gone. `serfs` (only while the world allows slavery): an owned prisoner put to work — no wage, its food. `make` — the limits of the master's properties.

kind_make._doc: v0.7.39.8: a kind of place the master makes (effect `property.new_kind`) — kept in the world's `place_kinds`; its income by the place's price as `make.income_day_pct`, wages and shift hours within these, a skill of rules.skills, its own upgrades (`upgrade_make`).

upgrade_make._doc: v0.7.39.8: an upgrade the master makes (a kind's own or effect `upgrade` at the hero's place) — the engine sets its price and days by what it gives: `base_cp` per key (`lesson_bonus`, `staff_max` per point), `income_pct` — the place's income × pct × `payback_days`, `produce` {item: qty a day} — the item's value × qty × `payback_days`, `produce_pct` — like income on the produce; days = price / `cp_per_day` within `days`. `caps` — the most a single upgrade gives. A new station (`station_new`) — its tools of rules.craft.tools; kept in the world's `stations`.

bank._doc: Bank (v0.7.28, BankRules): a financial contract is an engine concept — a deposit or a loan between the hero and a bank NPC (the pack's tag `bank` with optional `bank` terms on the NPC, or the master's effect `bank`), with the sum, the weekly rate, the term and the collateral. Interest by game days on the balance. A deposit: demand (taken any day) or a term one (early — without interest; after the term at the demand rate). A loan only against a collateral: a property with a deed (its value × ltv_pct.property) or a thing given in pawn (its price × ltv_pct.item, from item_min_cp); overdue — penalty_pct_day a day, after grace_days the collateral goes to the bank; a loan whose property was lost meanwhile — the debt becomes the crime `debt` of the bank's location (its wergild is the debt), and this bank lends no more. A vault keeps coins and things (safe from captivity and thieves) for fee_cp_week while not empty; unpaid fees are owed and paid before anything is taken. make — the limits of the master's lender.

shop._doc: Own trade (v0.7.29, ShopRules): a venue is the hero's place of a kind in `venues` (or with an upgrade that gives income_pct, the counter) or a stall rented at a room with `stall.room_tag` from the registry. The hero puts own things on the venue's shelf and sets the price as a percent of the value (price_pct). Each day a venue with a worker (or a serf) sells to `visitors` buyers: each picks a thing on the shelf (weight × competition — a pack trader of the location sells the same thing — or × scarce otherwise; a tavern's guests pick only food and drink) and buys it with the chance by the price ratio (buy_chance: [ratio, chance] points, linear); the takings go to the venue's till less the tax. The hero's own shift (`shift`) — a check of `skill` against `dc_tier`, its outcome (jobs.outcomes) × shift visitors, the takings to the purse. A charter (`charter`, from the registry for fee_cp) makes the trade lawful (tax_pct of the takings) and opens wholesale at the suppliers (NPC `wholesale` or the master's `supplier`: pct of the value, lots); without it the guard fines (fine_chance a day, fine_cp). The merchant's reputation of a location (`reputation`) grows by fair sales and good things, falls by dear sales and crude ones, and scales the visitors. A tavern's lodging: with an upgrade that gives rest, lodgers_share of the guests pay lodging_cp.

study._doc: Study (v0.7.30, StudyRules): a course is data — `teaches` {kind: skill | tool | language | spell | recipe | xp, id}, `lessons` (progress points to finish), the check of a lesson (`skill` or `ability`) against `dc`, `fee_cp` for the whole course, `xp` — class experience at the end (pack courses only), `requires` {level, classes}. A course is taught by a `teacher` (an NPC; the lesson goes while it is here, once a day, `lesson.hours`) or read from a `book` (an item the hero carries; no teacher, no fee, no misses). A course of a `school` needs the school's entrance `exam` (a check; a failure — again in `exam.retry_days`; a margin of `exam.stipend_margin` — a stipend: the school's courses for free); its end gives a diploma (a document item, jobs may require it). The school's `dorm` room — a free bed and a chest while the hero studies there. A gap of more than `gap_days` without a lesson is a miss; more than `misses_max` misses or a crime in the school's location — expelled, the school closed for `readmit_days`. Outcomes of a lesson by the margin (`outcomes`, the last whose `from` is reached): progress points and the direction «Учёность». `make` — the limits of the master's course (no class experience).

teachers._doc: Teachers (v0.7.39.7, TeachRules): who in the world may teach what. An NPC teaches by its own `teaches` {spells: {classes, max}, tools, skills, languages ([] or "own" — the ones it speaks), recipe_max_cp} merged with its SRD template (`templates`: the spell lists it teaches; the circle — the template's slots) and its trade kind (`trades`). Spells are taught only by such a teacher, up to its circle; a spell course costs `spell_fee_cp_lesson` × circle a lesson and lasts at least `spell_lessons_per_circle` × circle lessons; from circle `attitude_from_circle` the teacher asks attitude `attitude_min`. A recipe — by a teacher of its tool, its output worth at most `recipe_max_cp`. `find_max` — how many teachers the master's search answers, the nearest first.

bonds._doc: Bonds with NPCs (v0.7.31, BondRules): points per NPC in range; the kind (friend, romance after a confession, mentor after a course) names the steps, points below zero — a rival, an enemy. Points come from gifts by taste (one a day), the master's scenes (`bond`, ±scene.max_delta once a day) and the engine's deeds; perks go by points whatever the kind.

family._doc: Family (v0.7.32, FamilyRules): a proposal to the partner of a romance at its top step, a wedding at an officiant (an NPC with a tag of `officiants`) with a home of the hero (an owned place whose upgrades give `rest`); the spouse sleeps at home in `home_hours`. Children: a try at home with the spouse once a day by `conceive.chance` when one of the two can bear, birth after `conceive.days`; a year of a child is `days_per_year` game days, `stages` by years. Upkeep a day per person from the home's till, then the purse; unpaid — hunger: the spouse's bond falls, after `hunger.leave_days` the spouse leaves. The spouse and the grown children bring `help_cp` to the till. An adult child is the heir: the hero dead — play on as the heir, `heir.keep` of the character passes to it.

underworld._doc: The underworld (v0.7.33, the author: burglary, robbery, smuggling; a fence of the pack and the master's; an organization with a trial, ranks, jobs and a cut, a hideout, founded by the hero; the guard never learns of membership). A criminal job (HeistRules) — `kinds`: where and when the act is, its check (`act` skills or tool, the better one), preparations (`steps`, each once a day, a success gives `prep_bonus` to the act), what a failure brings (`fail`: crime, seized, fight) and the crime the victim reports (`crime`), `trace_chance` — a plain success leaves a trace: the crime is known. `outcomes` by the margin. A fence (FenceRules) buys stolen goods at `fence.buy_pct` of the value (honest traders of the owner's location refuse them) and sells `fence.stock` to those who know it: a criminal background's contact, a member of its organization, the master's `fence` with reveal. Organizations (OrgRules): ranks by points, a trial job, a cut of the loot owed to the head, unpaid past `owe_days` — expelled and the head an enemy; the hideout — rest, the guard does not look there. The hero founds one for `found_fee_cp` in an owned place; friends (bond `recruit_bond`) join and bring `member_income_cp` a day into its till, each caught by `member_caught_chance` a day.

office._doc: Offices (v0.7.34, the author: city service, the army, power over a settlement, the temple; appointed on conditions, promoted, elected or bought; decisions instead of shifts; bribes and removal). An office (OfficeRules) — world.json `offices`: {name, kind, location, room, chief (an NPC or "" for an election), ways (appoint, election, buy), price_cp, requires, interview, cases (kinds below), ranks [{name, at, pay_cp a week}], start_rank, town, projects}. Each day `cases_per_day` cases of its kinds wait at its room; an option is a check (`check` skill, `tier` → ok / fail) or plain `effects`: merit, rep (the settlement), pocket_cp, treasury_cp and discontent (the town), suspicion, attitude (the petitioner), flag. Suspicion falls by `suspicion_decay` a day; at `inquiry_at` — an inquiry (`inquiry` check): passed — halved, failed — removed and the crime `crime` known. Away `absent_days` — merit lost, `remove_absent_days` — removed. A town (`town`): treasury and discontent by days with the tax level; at `remove_at` the people remove the headman; projects take days and set a world flag.

council.name: сход
titles: Сход спорит о выпасе у реки

world_gen._reach: Where the master may grow a place (v0.7.22.22-pre, the author): on an open edge of any room of the hero's location, of the locations one exit away from it and of every location the hero has been to — not only of the room the hero stands in. find_places lists these edges; create_place names its room (`room_id`). The hero does not go there by it.
world_gen._doc: People and places the master makes (v0.7.20, WorldGen): an NPC by the pack's schema — a template of people (npc_templates, CR at most max_cr), a race of the SRD, links to NPCs of the world (link_kinds), a trader with goods of the catalog (each at most stock_item_cap_cp) and purse_cp; at most max_per_location new people in a location. A place (v0.7.20.1) — max_rooms rooms on an open edge of the pack; its encounter within the hard XP budget of the level.
world_gen._teaches: v0.7.39.7: a made person may `teaches` {tools, skills, languages: "own"} — what it can teach beside its trade; spells only by its template (rules.study.teachers.templates): a mage, a priest.
world_gen._places: v0.7.39.4: a place grows in one turn up to max_rooms rooms in its `sites`, with up to place_npcs_max people; a made room keeps up to 2 `open_edges` of its own (terrains of `terrains`) and the world goes on from it; an edge is not used up — roads fork. A location made with people or a settlement holds people_cap made NPCs (else max_per_location). `settlements` — what a hamlet, village or town always has: rooms [min, max], `needs` — site tags of which each must be there (one of the words), people at least, `law` — the guard of the town (`guard` — the law of the location, a new NPC with the template guard joins it).
world_gen._sites: Sites (v0.7.22.24): a made place is one site of its rooms; inside a location of reach (no open edge — a bathhouse an NPC spoke of); the world is endless — no limit of made rooms or sites (v0.7.22.26.2).

goal._doc: The hero's life goal (v0.7.22, GoalRules): the master names its scale and direction (class or a peaceful one); thresholds — the level of that direction from which the master may lead to it; above max_level — out of reach for now. The master never brings the goal up by itself. Batch 2 (v0.7.22.1): past the threshold, when the player asks or seeks, the master gives hints (goal_hint, counted); the quest for the goal (create_quest with for_goal) needs `hints` of them first.

quest_gen._doc: Quests the master makes (v0.7.21, QuestGen; v0.7.39.6 — by acts, see _difficulties): from a giver of the scene, 1..max_steps steps (talk, visit, find, fight) on what the world has, plus a return to the giver; at most max_open made quests taken at once and max_offered offered by one giver or board. Batch 2: a quest brings up to max_new_npcs new people, a place on an open edge and its thing in a hiding place; a person a quest made gives quests while its depth is below quest_depth. The reward by scale and the hero's level (1..5): reward_cp, class xp (only when a step is dangerous or the quest major), the giver's attitude.
quest_gen._board: v0.7.22.13 (big test #30, #31): a thing of the room whose name has one of board_words is a notice board — a window of its orders; reading an unread one is a master's turn that puts its orders up; the first order taken off it rolls board_refresh_days, after which it is unread again (an empty read board — again next day).
quest_gen._hide_skills: v0.7.38.5: the skills a quest's hidden thing may be found by (QuestItem.skill); Investigation finds any of them too
quest_gen._difficulties: v0.7.39.6 (the author): the difficulty of a quest — its acts and steps, its fights and their difficulty by the DMG (encounter_xp of the level, raw XP of the foes; a fight of the difficulty holds between half and the whole of its budget, the boss of the last act — up to the next one), a choice in the finale, a sequel; the reward by the hero's level (1..5) at the quest's making: reward_cp at its end, xp shared by the acts (class XP only for the dangerous or a major one), the giver's attitude. `warn` — «Точно?» before taking it.
quest_gen._encounter_xp: The DMG thresholds of an encounter for one hero by level 1..5 (raw XP of the foes, as xp_budget_hard): easy, medium, hard, deadly.

difficulty._doc: Difficulty of a game (M5, first iteration v0.7.20.4, DifficultyRules): check_bonus is added to the hero's checks and saving throws (death saves too), not to attacks. Chosen for a new game, changed in the settings.

followers._doc: NPCs who go with the hero (v0.7.20.3, FollowRules): the effect npc_follow — to one with an attitude of at least min_attitude or won over by a check this turn; at most max at once. v0.7.39.1: with the needs on a follower eats a portion of the hero's food a day; unfed — attitude −1 a day, after hungry_days it goes home; a long rest feeds it.

allies._doc: Allies in a fight (v0.7.22.22, AllyRules): fighters on the hero's side under the engine's AI — followers who join (not against the law's guard or the people of their own location), a pack encounter's `allies`, summoned creatures. summons — a spell → {monster, count, minutes (absent — until let go), helper (does not attack: the Help action, the hero's next attack at that foe with advantage)}; a concentration spell's creatures go when it ends. Followers at 0 HP fall unconscious and come to after the fight; a summoned one at 0 HP vanishes.

reputation._doc: Reputation in a settlement (v0.7.17, ReputationRules): points of the hero in a pack location with settlement: true; thresholds → steps −3…+3 (names); points by the engine's facts; master_max — the master's effect for a deed the place learned of; prices of every trader of the place (buy_pct the hero pays, sell_pct the trader pays) and the attitude of the people not dealt with yet (stranger_attitude).

discount._doc: A trader's discount by words (v0.7.15.2, effect npc_discount): min_pct..max_pct off buying, `days` days; only from an NPC with attitude ≥ min_attitude or one won over by a social check this turn.

thresholds._doc: Attitude thresholds (v0.7.15.3): at refuse_at and below the NPC will not talk or trade; at eager_at and above it offers help by its own roles and services.

favor._doc: A service of the NPC for free (v0.7.15.2, effect npc_favor): attitude ≥ min_attitude or won over this turn; one per NPC in cooldown_days.

conditions.blinded: Ослеплён: автоматически проваливает проверки, требующие зрения (Внимательность, Анализ); атаки по нему с преимуществом, его атаки с помехой.
conditions.charmed: Очарован: не может атаковать очаровавшего; тот совершает с преимуществом социальные проверки против него.
conditions.deafened: Оглох: ничего не слышит и автоматически проваливает проверки, требующие слуха.
conditions.exhaustion: Истощение: шесть степеней — 1: помеха на проверки; 2: скорость вдвое меньше; 3: помеха на атаки и спасброски; 4: максимум хитов вдвое меньше; 5: скорость 0; 6: смерть. Долгий отдых снимает всё.
conditions.frightened: Испуган: помеха на проверки и атаки, пока источник страха в поле зрения; не может к нему приближаться.
conditions.grappled: Схвачен: скорость 0; вырваться — действием, Атлетика или Акробатика.
conditions.incapacitated: Недееспособен: не может совершать действия и реакции; говорить и проходить проверки может.
conditions.invisible: Невидим: его нельзя увидеть без магии; его атаки с преимуществом, атаки по нему с помехой.
conditions.paralyzed: Парализован: недееспособен, не двигается и не говорит, проваливает спасброски Силы и Ловкости; атаки по нему с преимуществом, вплотную — критические.
conditions.petrified: Окаменел: недееспособен, сопротивление всему урону, проваливает спасброски Силы и Ловкости; атаки по нему с преимуществом.
conditions.poisoned: Отравлен: помеха на броски атаки и проверки характеристик.
conditions.prone: Лежит ничком: помеха на атаки; атаки по нему вблизи с преимуществом, издалека с помехой; встать — всё перемещение хода.
conditions.restrained: Опутан: скорость 0, помеха на атаки и спасброски Ловкости, атаки по нему с преимуществом.
conditions.stunned: Ошеломлён: недееспособен, проваливает спасброски Силы и Ловкости; атаки по нему с преимуществом.
conditions.unconscious: Без сознания: недееспособен, роняет всё, лежит ничком; атаки по нему с преимуществом, вплотную — критические.

glossary.advantage: Преимущество: бросаются две d20, берётся большая. Помеха — меньшая.
glossary.short_rest: Короткий отдых: не меньше часа; можно тратить Кости хитов.
glossary.long_rest: Долгий отдых: 8 часов; восстанавливает все хиты и половину Костей хитов. В этой игре снимает блокировку проваленных проверок.

spellcasting._doc: subclass_spells_ignored: the SRD import keeps Circle of the Land spells as one list for all terrains — not granted until the terrain picks them (backlog).

trade._doc: Trade (v0.5.3): buy = value × attitude % × (1 − haggle %), rounded up; sell = value × sell_ratio × attitude sell % × (1 + haggle %), rounded down. Haggle: Persuasion or Deception vs DC by attitude; the margin picks the tier; a failure locks haggling with this merchant until the next day.

stock_make._doc: v0.7.39.4, the master's effect `stock`: a thing the player asks a trader of the scene for and the shelf lacks — a catalog item or a new one, up to qty_max, at most per_day things a day per trader; magic by the hero's level.

kinds._doc: Kinds of shops (v0.7.22.26): a trader's ready goods by its trade, so the master never makes them. A trader's kind — its `trade_kind` (pack or create_npc), else the first kind with a word of its role. `stock` — what it always has (a pack NPC's own stock goes first), `extras` — per_day more goods from `pool` each day (qty within the range), picked by the game's seed; `wants` — what it buys gladly when the NPC has none of its own; `purse_cp` — the purse of a made trader.

demand._doc: Demand (v0.7.17.1): what a trader buys gladly (`wants` of the pack NPC; else the item types that make default_share of its stock), what it will not buy (`shuns`), the rest — other goods. Tags of an item: its item_type, magic (not common), scroll, tool and its own `tags`. The sell price: value × sell_ratio × wanted / other × saturation (each unit of the same item sold lately −saturation_step, down to saturation_floor; recover_per_day units a day) × attitude × reputation × haggle, within min_ratio…max_ratio of the value.

xp._doc: Experience only from combat (by monster CR) and quests of the pack (v0.5.4); the master cannot grant it.

resources._doc: Feature uses (v0.6.0): who has them (features), how many (max: fixed | class_specific with default | ability_mod with min and plus | per_level), when they come back (short | long; short_with: a feature that makes it short). on_use: what the engine does itself (heal [count, sides, bonus] where bonus may be "level"; heal_amount — heals the points spent). combat_cost: what a use costs in a fight (action by default, bonus, free).

rest._doc: short_rest_slot_features: who gets spell slots back on a short rest (warlock's Pact Magic).

consumables._doc: Items the engine applies when used (v0.6.0): heal [count, sides, bonus], remove [conditions]. Thrown in a fight (v0.7.12, the «Предметы» tab, PHB): `throw` — a ranged attack (improvised: no proficiency; range ft) and on a hit `damage` [dice, type] (only to `types` when given), `burning` dice at the start of the foe's turn until a DEX save DC 10 puts it out, `oiled` — the next fire damage to the foe +N, `condition` with an escape (a STR save each turn, `escape_dc`) on foes up to `max_size`. A catalog item may carry its own `use` (potions, the ointment, scrolls, wands).

condition_effects._doc: What a condition does to engine checks (SRD; v0.7.8): checks | skills {id} | saves {ability} | senses {sight, hearing}: disadvantage | auto_fail. A sense comes with the master's check (a check that needs sight or hearing). Incapacitated and stunned heroes still make checks: the master decides whether they can try.

feature_spells._doc: Spells a feature lets the hero cast at will, without a slot (v0.7.22.4, big test #15: «Туманные видения» gave no spell): the warlock's invocations; they come into c.spells.free and cast at their own circle.

body._doc: Age, build and height of the hero and the NPCs (v0.7.22.5, BodyRules, the author's choice: words, not numbers): the engine picks each by `weight` (the hero — by `hero_weight`), its own word for men and women; an id without a female or male word is not offered to that gender. A child and a teenager (weight 0) come only when a pack or the master sets them. v0.7.22.15: the player may choose each word at the creation of the hero — any of its gender's list but those with `hero: false`; what is not chosen the engine picks.

encounters._doc: Meetings and captivity (v0.7.22.12, EncounterRules): sneaking in unseen — the foes lurk, no fight; talking first — one roll against the parley DC of the fight; a lost fight to thinking foes — captivity: Athletics or Sleight of Hand against escape_dc (a failure costs escape_fail_minutes), or Persuasion against the parley DC.
encounters._v07_22_17: Captivity, whole (v0.7.22.17): «Сдаться» in a fight — at once the captive of thinking foes; to the law's guard — held, as at an arrest. The captors take the hero's things into a container of the room (seized_container, made when the room has none): taken back from it once free.

doors._doc: Doors (v0.7.22.25, DoorRules): a way between rooms may have a door — the pack's own (a room's `doors` {to: {material, lock, key, locked}}) or the entrance of a site with hours (`default`). Outside the site's hours it is locked. A key or picked lock (Sleight of Hand against containers.lock_dc of its `lock`) opens it until the site's next opening; force (Athletics, the pick DC + containers.force_dc_plus + the material's force_plus) breaks it; blows of the weapon in hand — an attack against the material's ac, damage off its hp; an arcane lock adds arcane_plus to both and only Knock quiets it for knock_minutes; fire (a spell of the fire damage type or a `torch`) burns a wooden door through in burn_minutes. Each try takes try_minutes. Forcing a way into a closed or private site before eyes is a trespass at once.

sites._doc: Sites (v0.7.22.24, SiteRules): a private room (`public` false of the room or its site) of a site with a living owner — entering it unasked before eyes: the owner trespass_attitude and a light crime `trespass` where there is law, once a day a site. Asked in: the owner goes with the hero or likes the hero from welcome_attitude.

permit._doc: The owner's leave (v0.7.39.2, SiteRules.ask / grant): «Попросить впустить» — a check of `skill` against the owner (SocialRules.dc at `tier`), a failure — again tomorrow; the master's `permit` and an organization's paid entry give it too. It lasts while the owner's attitude is not below min_attitude (the author: until a quarrel).

creatures._doc: The creatures a fight leaves in the room (v0.7.22.11, CreatureRules): those of a truce, the surrendered and the knocked out stay; unbound they go after leave_minutes of their state (0 — they stay); a bound one stays and can be led.
creatures._v07_22_16: A creature keeps hp and xp_given (fought again — its wounds, no XP twice); the helpless (unconscious or bound) is finished off without a fight. A pack NPC knocked out lies as a creature with its npc_id; waking or let go it goes home with woken_attitude and the assault is known (crime kind `assault`).
creatures._v07_22_17: The prisoner's branch (v0.7.22.17, docs/design/concepts.md «Пленник»): a bound one is the hero's (owner `hero`, OwnerRules). Handed to the law's guard — bounty_cp_per_xp × its XP and hand_over_reputation in the settlement; executed (finished off bound) before NPCs — execute_attitude for each who sees; sold (the master's `owner` with price_cp) — at most sale_cp_per_xp × its XP and the buyer's purse; a thinking one is not sold while slavery is off (v0.7.27 makes it a setting of the world).

wear_slots._doc: Slots of worn things (v0.7.22.9, big test #24): a wondrous item goes to the slot of its `look` (or its own `slot`; a made one — by the first word of its name); it works only worn. Without a slot (a stone, a pearl, a wand) it works carried.

trait_cantrips._doc: Cantrips a race trait grants (the SRD import has no spell list in traits, v0.6.0).

theft._rearm: v0.7.22.8 (big test #3): a weapon stolen from an NPC's belt is gone from its hands in a fight (another weapon of its statblock, or the fists) for rearm_days.
theft._doc: Theft (v0.7.0): the pockets of an NPC — the pack's `pockets` list or by its monster template (pockets: coins_dice × unit_cp in a purse, item_count things of `items`, worn weapons of the SRD statblock). DC of an entry = max(10, passive Perception) + dc modifiers. Caught (or a thing of the owner taken before its eyes) — caught_attitude, then the reaction by template (reactions; traders close the shop for the day): fight, call_guard (fine_cp, or a fight with guard_monster when the player cannot pay). Words without the window take only the purse.

reward_budget._doc: The master's rewards between long rests (v0.7.14.3, DMG treasure by level): coins and things the master gives (`coins` up, `give_item` outside quests) together cost at most per_rest_cp of the hero's level until the next long rest; quest rewards, fights, thefts and searches are not counted. A success on a nearly_impossible check this turn lets the master give at most impossible_share of what is left. A magic thing (not common, v0.7.22.2) is not counted by its price: at most magic_per_rest of them until the long rest, each in a turn with a check that passed.

crime._doc: Crimes of the hero (v0.7.14, CrimeRules): a pack NPC killed in a fight the hero began. Witnesses (the living NPCs of the room) know at once and like the hero witness_attitude less; a hidden body is found after found_minutes. Known — every NPC of the location attitude; in a location with `law` (pack) the hero is wanted: traders and givers turn away, a guard NPC or a patrol (after search_minutes) holds the hero — wergild fine_cp a crime (×notable_mult for a victim with notable_tags), or stocks_days a crime in the stocks, or a fight with patrol_size guards. Settled — the location forgives `forgiven`. v0.7.22.2 (big test): Persuasion / Deception / Intimidation against talk_tier (a step harder for each crime past the first and a notable victim), each once a hold, or a bribe of bribe_share × the wergild — let go but still wanted; nobody holds the hero there for let_go_minutes (after a resist too), then a guard NPC holds and a patrol comes by patrol_chance a step. While held the master may lead the hero to any room of the location (`move`) and let go after a check passed at the talk tier (`crime_release`). A body gives its pockets and body_wares things of its wares.

kinds._doc: Kinds of crimes (v0.7.22.16): severity — how much each adds to the sentence (a sentence by the sum), fine_cp — its wergild (murder — fine_cp above), name — in the lines. v0.7.22.24: known_attitude — the location's attitude when it is known (0 — none; murder — `attitude` above, assault −1), reputation_share — the part of the crime_known points it costs (0 — none), memory — what the people remember ({victim}).

pickpocket.name: карманная кража
pickpocket.memory: знает: герой шарил по чужим карманам

trespass.name: вторжение
trespass.memory: знает: герой без спроса вломился к {victim}

corruption.name: мздоимство
corruption.memory: знает: герой брал мзду на службе

poaching.name: браконьерство
poaching.memory: знает: герой бил зверя в угодьях {victim}

crime._v07_22_10: Crime and punishment 2.0 (v0.7.22.10, big test #5, #7, #9, #38): a sentence by severity — the open crimes of the location, +1 for a notable victim — from `sentences` (the highest that fits): prison or hard labour for `days`, the hero wakes in the law's `prison` room (pack) with the wounds healed, labour adds exhaustion; no execution (ADR-0010: no death out of a fight). Paid or served — no more wanted, but nobody forgives (`forgiven` 0, no reputation back). A hidden body (`hide`: a check of `skill`, its total is the hiding DC) is searched once a day: d20 + search_bonus against the DC + day_step a day searched — harder each day; an unhidden one is found after found_minutes. A known body is buried after bury_days (a line in the chronicle).
crime._v07_22_18: The sequence of a crime (v0.7.22.18): waiting where the law is goes in wait_step minutes — the patrol looks in after each and stops the wait; people of the room come to the help of an NPC the hero attacks (`defend`: the law's guards and NPCs with its tags, not the hero's friends from friend_attitude); the wanted hero gets no services and no paid bed (`rest_cost_cp` > 0) where he is wanted.

revisit._doc: A room the master already described today (v0.7.22.20, the author's fixes check #8): entered again with nothing on the way, the engine says one of these lines ({place} — the room's name) and who is here, with no master's turn. A pack may give its own (world.json `revisit`).

props._abandon: v0.7.22.8 (big test #28): what the hero dropped in the world is gone after abandon_hours (someone took it); a thing put into a container stays.
props._doc: Things of the rooms (v0.7.0): the master furnishes a room on its first visit — up to max_per_room things; portable ones are catalog items, each worth at most item_value_cap_cp, together at most room_value_cap_cp of the character's level.

time._doc: Time of day (v0.6.3): minutes since midnight. A step between rooms of one location — move_minutes, into another location — travel_minutes; a short rest — short_rest_minutes; a long rest ends at wake_minute. Parts start at `from`; night — traders closed (night_shops_closed), darkness outside lit locations.

combat._doc: Combat (v0.6.1, ADR-0010 §7): 7 columns of 30 ft on a line (−3…3), the player starts at 0; a move is one column (speed ≥ 60 — two), Dash one more. Spells the engine resolves itself — engine_spells (the rest go to the master as improvisation); multi: several darts or rays. Morale: a WIS save at half HP or when the leader falls; intelligent foes (INT ≥ intelligent_int) surrender, the rest flee. XP budget per character level for the master's fights (DMG, hard); in a fight the master's reinforcement keeps the foes in play within it and comes after reinforce_delay rounds; a foe's call for help (pack encounter help) — after help_delay.
combat._bg3: v0.7.22.3, the author's choice (as in BG3, not 5e): drinking a potion is a bonus action (potion_cost; an action when no bonus is left), the off-hand light weapon strikes as a bonus action without the main hand's attack first (offhand_needs_attack).
combat._attack_npc: v0.7.22.16 (the author's fixes check #32): the hero attacks an NPC of the scene by the button «Напасть» or by a hostile spell or a weapon pinned to the words with the NPC as its target — the engine starts the fight, the hero acts first; an NPC whose attitude is at least unaware_attitude (and who is not hostile) does not expect it — caught off guard.

condition_spells._doc: Condition spells the engine resolves (v0.6.5): conditions for `rounds` (foe turns), a save against the spell DC (or a hit point `pool` + `pool_per_slot` — the weakest first), `repeat_save` at the end of the foe's turn, `ends_on_damage`, `types` it works on / `immune_types`, `immune_condition` (Sleep: those immune to charm), `min_int`, `area` (the target's column; range 0 — the player's).

command._words: v0.7.22.3 (big test #22): Command speaks one word of 5e — Grovel (prone, the turn lost), Halt, Flee (a column away), Drop (the weapon in hand falls); the caster picks a word that does something now.

lore_skills._doc: Inspect a foe (v0.6.6): the knowledge skill by creature type, DC = lore_base_dc + CR rounded up; success opens the kind for good.

parley._doc: Parley in a fight (v0.6.2; a challenge since v0.7.5): every try costs the action and rolls Intimidation or Persuasion against DC = base_dc + the best WIS save of intelligent foes + per_cr × the highest CR among them + per_defeated for every foe out of the fight + per_bloodied for every foe below half HP + hard (an encounter of the pack with "parley": "hard" — finales, fanatics), not below min_dc. `successes` before `failures` win: the skill of the deciding success sets the outcome (Intimidation — surrender or flight, Persuasion — truce); `failures` — they will not listen until the end of the fight.

carry._doc: Carrying capacity (v0.7.7, PHB): Strength × per_str pounds; over it the hero cannot leave the room. Coins weigh nothing in this version.

equip_minutes._doc: Changing armour out of a fight (v0.7.7, PHB): minutes to don / doff by category; a shield and weapons take no minutes (in a fight a shield and armour cannot change, a weapon is drawn free once a turn, then for the action).

invisibility._doc: Invisibility (v0.7.5): the hero is invisible with the condition `invisible` or while concentrating on one of `spells`. Those who would see them get `passive_penalty` off passive Perception (5e disadvantage); in a fight the hero attacks with advantage and is attacked with disadvantage; an attack or a spell ends a spell with ends_on_attack (5e Invisibility; Greater Invisibility stays). Talking does not end it: NPCs hear a voice.

diseases._doc: Diseases (v0.7.23.1, DiseaseRules): a disease is caught on a failed save (CON, tag disease — Divine Health, the Periapt of Health are immune), hidden for incubation_hours, then shows for `days` as one effect «Болезнь: …» with its symptoms — conditions, saves with disadvantage, max HP lost, a need dropped once (needs: {need: −points}) — and passes by itself. herbs: true — herbs and the herbalist cure it; magic (Lesser Restoration, the priestess, 5 points of Lay on Hands) cures any. contagious — a sick NPC (npc `sick` in the pack) passes it on at a meeting, once a day. Sources: a bite of a monster (`disease` in the attack's effect), water of a room tagged foul_water (drunk there or filled into the skin), foul food (foul_food: item → disease and DC, eaten last), the master's `disease` effect (a known one or made by `make` limits). A pack adds its own in world.json `diseases`.

rot_fever.name: Гнилая лихорадка
rot_fever.line: болен гнилой лихорадкой: жар, слабость, рана гноится
rot_fever.text: Жар, ломота и гноящийся укус. Отравлен: помеха на броски атаки и проверки; максимум хитов −4. Травы не помогают — только магия или время.

sewer_plague.name: Чума нечистот
sewer_plague.line: болен чумой нечистот: тошнит, мучит жажда
sewer_plague.text: Тошнота и озноб от гнилой воды или еды. Помеха на спасброски Телосложения, жажда сразу сильнее. Лечат травы, магия или время.

cackle_fever.name: Хохочущая лихорадка
cackle_fever.line: болен хохочущей лихорадкой: приступы безумного смеха
cackle_fever.text: Жар и приступы безумного смеха, заразна для тех, кто рядом. Отравлен; помеха на спасброски Мудрости. Лечат травы, магия или время.

craft._doc: Crafting (v0.7.24, CraftRules): a recipe is data — `tool` (the hero must be proficient and carry it), `station` (a room tag of `stations`, "" — anywhere), `hours` of work, `dc` of the craft check (d20 + the tool's ability of `tools` + proficiency + the game's difficulty), `materials` {item: qty} spent at the start, `output` × `qty`. Known: every recipe of a proficient tool without `learn`; a `learn` one — taught for pay (service op teach_recipe), from a carried book (item `teaches`) or made by the master (effect `recipe`). Work goes in shifts of `work_hours`, the progress kept in c.craft; a station in a room with its trader present costs `rent_cp_hour`. The check at the end sets the quality by the margin (`quality`, the last tier whose `from` is reached): the value ×`value`, a stack's qty ×`qty`, the `props` by the item type and the name suffix. `salvage` — an item with a recipe gives `share` of its materials back (floor, at least 1 of the first), `extra` for items without one; `hides` — raw hides from a dead beast by size, into the loot; `gather` — room tags where a button gets raw material (a check; `per_day` times a day per room); `make` — the limits of the master's recipes. Kitchen (v0.7.25): `minutes` instead of `hours`; a `simple` recipe is known to anyone and needs no tool in the pack (the proficiency adds only when proficient); a station's `tags` — the room tags that count, `wild` — anywhere outside a settlement (a campfire); `meat` — raw meat from a dead beast by size; a gather spot's `items` — one of them is found.

make._doc: v0.7.39.4: any item may get a recipe — the work pays what the materials do not, by 5e (5 gp a day of 8 hours): hours = max(the master's, (the output's value − the materials') / labor_cp_hour), up to hours[1]; `skills` — the «Ремесло» skills a recipe of this tool and item asks (the first match), as the pack's.

craft.templates_doc: v0.7.39.1, the direction «Артефакция»: a template makes a recipe of a catalog item (`match`: item_type, prop, prefix, scroll, plain) — id tpl:<template>:<item>[:<variant>]. from_base — the item's `base` is a material (shown while the hero carries it); from_self — the plain item itself is the material and the output a new thing with a `variants` property (its name suffix); spell_known — a scroll of a spell the hero knows; learn — only a learned formula (a lesson, a book, the master). tool / station "$base" — those of the base's own recipe (or *_default); its skills are asked too. `check` — the skill of a tool-less check. by_rarity — the dust (× the skill's dust_mult), the hours and the DC by the output's rarity. A template is listed only when the hero has its `skills` (a learned formula always).

needs._doc: Needs of the hero (v0.7.23, NeedRules): a scale 0–100 that empties over `hours` of the game clock from the last meal or drink and fills by eating (camp food points × points) or drinking (drink); `stages` by the value below `below` — a chip, the master's line and the checks they hamper (saves: ability → disadvantage); at 0 — a level of exhaustion each full day past grace_days ("3+con": 3 + CON modifier, at least 1). sleep is shown from the hours awake (hero_effects.exhaustion.awake_hours), its exhaustion stays the awake saves. Water (v0.7.34.6, VesselRules): each vessel of `vessels` (catalog id → pints it holds, `weight` empty if the catalog gives it full) keeps its own pints of water and whether they are foul; a drink takes drink_pints, water weighs lb_per_pint. Filled where the room has the tag `water` (`foul_water` — foul), a thing of the room with `source` (water | foul_water), or a thing whose name has one of water_words; drinking there is free. A bed in a settlement (an inn, a temple) feeds and waters (rest_meal). Switched by the game setting `needs` (on by default). Food spoils (v0.7.25, FoodRules): an item's `spoils_days` — a carried batch turns into `spoil_to` that many days after it was got; a dish's `meal` in consumables — water points and temp_hp on eating, its adv_tag a boon.

hero_effects._doc: Effects on the hero (v0.7.8): a condition or a boon with its source, duration, save and concentration. Durations are in rounds (10 a minute) of the game clock: round, minute, ten_minutes, hour, eight_hours; or short_rest / long_rest / until_removed. A save names its tag (save_tags): race traits give advantage against it (trait_saves) or immunity (trait_immune). Damage to the hero: resistances of race traits (trait_resist; damage_resistance — the draconic ancestry), of Rage, of items (item_resist), of effects; petrified — resistance to all. spell_cures: what a spell cast on the hero lifts (remove), how much exhaustion it takes away, and the boon it leaves (adv_tag, resist, duration). exhaustion: forced march — each hour of travel past march_hours a day, a CON save DC march_dc + hours past; a day awake — each awake_hours without a long rest, a CON save DC awake_dc + awake_dc_step per day before; a long rest takes all exhaustion away (decision of the author, ADR-0010). camp: a long rest outside an inn costs `need` points of food (food: item → points).

class_features._doc: Class features in the engine (v0.7.10, FeatureRules): Font of Magic — sorcery points for a slot by circle; metamagic — the cost in points and what it does (quickened: a bonus action; empowered: the damage dice twice, the better; heightened: the first save of the target with disadvantage; distant: double range; extended: double rounds); careful, twinned and subtle stay with the master (no allies, social). Sacred Weapon lasts 10 rounds; Song of Rest — a die on a short rest when hit dice are spent.

languages._doc: Languages (v0.7.11, LanguageRules): NPCs of the pack without `languages` speak Common and the language of their people (by_race: the start of the Russian race word). understand_spells: a spell cast on oneself that lets the hero understand every tongue for an hour.

backgrounds._doc: Background features (v0.7.11, BackgroundRules): `ties` — the tag of the pack's NPCs who like the hero from the start (+1 attitude) and `tie_text` for the master; temple_rest — a free long rest in a room tagged temple; forage — a camp without food once a day outside settlements; wayfinder — a quarter less on the way outside settlements; stage_lodging — a show on a stage gives a free room that night; `master` — the rule for the master. _perform — the pay of a show by the Performance total.

folk_hero.tie_text: простой человек: уважает героя из народа, спрячет и накормит
folk_hero.master: простые люди укроют героя, если он не опасен им самим, и не выдадут страже

soldier.master: солдаты и стража уважают звание героя: слушают, пропускают, дают на время коня или снаряжение

sage.master: если герой чего-то не знает, он знает, где и у кого это узнать: подскажи место или человека из мира

outlander.master: герой помнит карты и местность, вне поселений находит еду и воду для себя (лагерь без припасов раз в день)

entertainer.master: за выступление в таверне или на площади герою дают ночлег и еду; публика его узнаёт

tools._doc: Tools in checks (v0.7.11, BackgroundRules.tool_check): the master's check names `tool`; the hero proficient with it and carrying it adds the proficiency bonus, or gets advantage when also proficient in a skill of `skills` (XGtE); `required` — without the tool the check fails (a lock without thieves' tools).

item_rules._doc: Items by 5e (v0.7.12, ItemRules): attunement — up to `attune_max` items, an hour with the item (`attune_minutes`) out of a fight; a found magic item (rarity above common) is unidentified until a short rest with it, an attunement, Identify or a trader's service; ammunition by the weapon (`ammo`), half the spent comes back after the fight (`recover`); `element_dice` — the extra damage of a weapon with fire_damage and the like; `small_races` — heavy weapons with disadvantage; `scrolls` — DC and attack bonus by the circle (DMG); `max_found_rarity` — what the master may hand out at levels 1-5 (quest rewards of the pack excepted).

services._doc: Services of NPCs (NPC `services` in the pack; a pack may add its own in world.json `services`), v0.7.16 by pillar 6 — a service is data over an operation of the engine (`op`): identify — every unknown item the hero carries; lift_curse — the cursed items come off (they stay cursed); enchant — one carried item of `needs` (weapon | armor | any) from the catalog gets `property` from the item properties and the name «… (`suffix`)», its value + the cost; teach_recipe (v0.7.24) — the hero learns `recipe` (needs the proficiency of its tool). `name` — the button, `short` — for the lines and the master, `done` — the line of the result. Silver: PHB 100 gp.

spell_effects._doc: Spells that change numbers (v0.7.13, SpellEffects): on the hero — die (a bonus die to the rolls of `on`: attack, save, check; `once` — one roll), next_attack_adv, immune [conditions], temp_hp each turn (MOD — the spellcasting modifier); on foes (`foe`) — a save of up to `targets` foes (+1 per slot above), a failed one keeps the minus die on its attacks and saves. Defenses (v0.7.13.2): ac_base (unarmored: base + DEX), ac_plus, ac_min; attackers_dis; images (Mirror Image: d20 6/8/11+ hits an image, AC 10 + DEX); sanctuary (a WIS save or no attack; ends when the hero attacks a foe); temp_dice (+temp_per_slot); max_hp_plus (+per_slot) with as much healing; resist / resist_auto (the most common damage type of the foes, fire by default), adv_tag, remove; foe_types_dis — those types attack with disadvantage; save_adv [abilities], death_adv, max_heal (healing rolls its maximum). Movement and form (v0.7.13.3): speed_x2 and haste (one more action: one weapon attack, Dash, Disengage, Dodge; a turn of lethargy when it ends), flying (foes without a ranged attack cannot reach the hero), blink (d20 11+ at the end of the hero's turn — gone until their next turn), speed_plus, bonus_dash, teleport (a column away from the nearest foe, no opportunity attacks), enlarged, darkvision, see_invisible, skill_bonus, ability_adv (best — the hero's highest ability). On the weapon (v0.7.13.4): shillelagh [bases] — the spellcasting ability, d8, magic; weapon_plus (plus_at_slot); weapon_extra [dice, type] on every hit; next_hit — the next hit's dice by the slot (next_dice); mark — +dice on hits at the marked foe (foe_target: cast at a foe; moved by a bonus action when it falls); blade — a melee spell attack with blade_dice by the slot. Sustained (v0.7.13.5): `sustained` — attack (a spell attack again each turn by `cost`; drain — half back as hit points), heat (the same foe takes the dice, CON save or disadvantage on its attacks), strike (a save in the target's column), zone (a column of the field: a save or damage when a foe starts its turn there, enters it or ends its turn there; `follow` — the hero's column; `move` — columns the button moves it; `ram` — the sphere strikes where it moves; `slow` — a foe in it moves half); `dice` — when the spell has no damage by slot (spike growth: 2d4 per 5 ft ≈ 6d4 per 30-ft column). Control (v0.7.13.6): zones — `now` (at once on who stands there), `cond` (a failed save lays it: Grease — prone), obscure (Fog Cloud, Darkness: attacks into or out of the column have disadvantage, inside both — even), silence (no spells with a verbal component inside), retch (Stinking Cloud: the turn is lost), block_ranged (Wind Wall: ranged weapon attacks through the column miss); push (Gust of Wind: a STR save or a column away, `reach` columns); `curse` — a flag on foes by a save (or a spell attack): outlined (Faerie Fire: advantage at it, no invisibility), enfeebled (half damage of its weapons), cursed_dis (its attacks at the hero with disadvantage), slowed_spell (AC −2, half the way, no reactions, one attack); `repeat` — a save at the end of its turn ends it. Reactions (v0.7.13.7, the window «Использовать?»): `reaction` hit (Shield: +5 AC until the hero's turn, the hit may miss), damage (Hellish Rebuke: the attacker takes the dice, DEX half), spell (Counterspell: a foe's spell of circle 3 or less fails, higher — a check DC 10 + circle); dispel (Dispel Magic: the target foe's spells on the hero end; calmed — Calm Emotions: the foe lowers its weapon); npc_save (out of a fight: the NPC's save by its monster template, `types` it works on; the master narrates the outcome; v0.7.22.3 — a spell that holds stays on the NPC for `minutes` (a concentration one — while the hero holds it): advantage on the hero's social checks against it; when it ends the NPC knows — `aftermath` attitude); lift_curse; make — items made (Goodberry, Create Food and Water). The world (v0.7.13.8): light — a light source while it lasts (darkness goes); reveal — trap (Find Traps: the room's traps are found) or magic (Detect Magic: caches with magic things are found, unknown things in the pack show their aura); knock — the room's closed things open, loudly.

calendar._doc: Календарь и праздники (v0.7.44, CalendarRules). Календарь — данные пакета (world.json `calendar`): месяцы, неделя, сезоны, праздники. near_days — на сколько дней вперёд праздник виден на панели, в журнале и мастеру. make — праздник мастера (эффект `festival`): начнётся не позже max_ahead дней, длится до max_days, цены у торговцев локации — buy_pct и sell_pct в этих границах; один праздник мастера за раз в локации.

pets._doc: Питомцы (v0.7.43, PetRules). Приручить можно зверя SRD (type beast) размером до max_size и CR до max_cr: дикого в комнате (метка комнаты пакета `beasts`, эффект мастера `beast`) или побеждённого (перемирие, сдался). Проверка skill против Сл dc: base + CR × per_cr + state по состоянию; угощение его вкуса (eats → tastes) — преимущество; провал на flee_margin и больше — убегает, иначе завтра снова. Что даёт — из шаблона SRD: help_traits — черты острых чувств → преимущество на эти навыки, пока питомец рядом (близость не меньше close.help_from); fights — от min_size и min_cr дерётся рядом; scout — летает быстрее min_fly: per_day раз в день облетает непройденный выход — комната видна на карте с опасностью; kinds — поверх выведенного (кот — spoil_mult: еда в вещах героя хранится дольше). Корм — feed_cp_day по размеру, сперва вещь его вкуса из вещей героя; близость — кормление с руки (close.feed, раз в день) и сцена мастера (`bond` с creature_id, до close.scene_max); голод терпит property.starve_days и день на каждые close.stay_per близости. make.per_day — зверей мастера в день.

mounts._doc: Ездовые и вьючные (v0.7.42, MountRules). Животное героя с `pack` (property.animals) несёт вьюк: ёмкость по 5e — Сила × 15 × size_mult размера (burden — на размер больше), вещи вьюка не в весе героя. Повозка (vehicles) запрягается в животное с `pull` не меньше своего и едет с ним: свой контейнер `capacity_lb`. Куда нельзя: комната под крышей (indoor) без метки `stable` / `mounts`, метка `no_mounts`, местность из no_mount_terrains без `mounts`; повозка — ещё и только по местности cart_terrains или с меткой `road`. Животное, что не прошло, ждёт у входа и снова идёт с героем, когда он вернётся. Без присмотра вне своего места: корма нет (голод → уходит через property.starve_days), и каждый день steal_pct_day — уведут вместе с вьюком. Аренда у барышника — rent_pct_day цены в день на rent_days, по сроку животное уходит к хозяину; продажа своего — sell_pct цены. make — что мастер может поставить барышнику (`stock` с `animal`): зверь SRD этих размеров и CR, цена по размеру, путь по скорости.

wilds._doc: Угодья (v0.7.41): комната с тегом вида (game, fish) — запас зверя или рыбы; улов тратит запас, он отрастает по regen_per_day до stock. Проверка skill против dc, сверх Сл каждые units_per_margin — ещё единица (до max_per_try за попытку), попыток — часы / hours_per_try. gear_adv — преимущество, без gear_needed — помеха. Дичь — по terrain локации: yield сразу, monster — мясо и шкуры по размеру, fight — бой. Провал — хищник с шансом predator_pct (на 1 — всегда). Чужие угодья (wilds_owner комнаты или хозяин места) без позволения — poach.crime, замечено при людях или с шансом seen_pct.

arena._doc: The arena (v0.7.45, ArenaRules): a site with `arena` {rule} of the kind `arena`, its manager — the staff of `manager_role` (or the owner). `rules` — what a rule means: `yield` (to surrender: the hero's blows only knock out, the hero at 0 HP loses, a fighter gives up at `yield_hp_pct`), `death` (the blood pit: no surrender, the downed is finished; the prize and the fame by `prize_pct`, `fame_pct`). Enlisting costs `fee_cp`; one bout a day; `ranks` — the ladder: SRD templates of the opponents, the prize, the wins that lift the rank. Bets: `bet` (`min_cp` … `max_cp_level` × level; the payout (1 − `house_pct`) / the house's chance, at most `max_mult`; the house's chance is the engine's estimate off by up to `noise_pct`), `insight` — the check that shows the true estimate; `card_ranks` — the ranks of the day's NPC bout; `sim_rounds` — its rounds at most. `fame` — points of the settlement's reputation: a win, a new rank, a tournament won. `nicknames` — of the fighters.

yield.name: до сдачи
yield.text: бой идёт, пока боец не сдастся или не упадёт без чувств; убивать нельзя — удары только оглушают

death.name: до смерти
death.text: кровавая яма: сдаться нельзя, упавшего добивают; приз и слава вдвое

contests._doc: Contests (v0.7.40, ContestRules): a game of the hero with an NPC of the scene for a stake. A kind — `check` of each side ({skill} | {ability} | {save}; `npc_check` when the NPC rolls another), `tool` (a gaming set: proficiency adds, as for any check), `wins` — rounds to win, `lose` — what the loser of the whole game gets ({condition, ends}), `cheat` — the skill of cheating (none — no cheating), its opposite `cheat_against`. A round: both roll, the higher total takes it, a tie — nobody. Cheating: the hero's cheat skill against the NPC's roll of `cheat_against`; higher — the round is the hero's, else caught: the stake is lost and the NPC reacts as to a caught theft. A stake: coins (`stake.min_cp` … `stake.max_cp_level` × level, no more than the NPC's purse) or a thing of the NPC (`things`: an item of its pockets up to `item_cap_cp`, its leave to walk in — `permit_cp`, a secret — `secret_cp`) against the hero's coins of its worth. `per_npc_day` games with one NPC a day; `min_attitude` — who plays at all. `make` — the bounds of the master's own kind. A kind with `bout` (v0.7.45) is a duel: after the stake, a fight to surrender with the NPC's template by the arena's way (ArenaRules).
